mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates a weakening labor market that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) signals a stagflationary environment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105 AND CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases risk-free rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPIAUCSL above 250 signals persistent inflation, which triggers central bank rate hikes and increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained housing starts rate below 1000 (HOUST < 1000) indicates a weak housing market and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals a strong labor market and accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer spending (RSAFS) is indicative of strong economic activity, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 5-year median.
